name: Lekythoi
legendaryAbilityText: When you pass, you may exhaust this card to immediately score 1 public objective if you fulfill its requirements.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Let's drink. For Hades is our common harbor.
flavourText: *A world sized tomb carved from crimson granite, holding the silent ashes and preserved memories of empires that fell long before the Lazax ever looked to the stars.*
